open to applications
acf.s026_p: Two New Zealand investor visa programs are open to applications. Both give the whole family residence, with a route to permanent residence and citizenship.
acf.s044_p: Growth category — NZ$5 million, held for 3 years
acf.s045_li: Direct investment in New Zealand private companies
acf.s046_li: Managed funds and venture capital funds approved by NZTE
acf.s047_p: Balanced category — NZ$10 million, held for 5 years
acf.s048_li: Direct investment, managed funds, listed shares
acf.s053_li: Children under 24, unmarried and financially dependent

acf.s057_p: Free public healthcare and free public schooling for your children through the end of secondary school
acf.s058_p: After 4 years of maintaining the investment, you can apply for a Permanent Resident Visa
acf.s059_p: After 5 years of residence, you can apply for New Zealand citizenship
acf.s061_p: A very high investment threshold — it suits few investors
acf.s062_p: Higher financial risk than passive programs
acf.s079_li: Standard route: NZ$1 million, held for 3 years

acf.s081_li: Purpose: temporary residence leading to New Zealand permanent residence
acf.s082_li: INZ has accepted applications since November 2025
acf.s084_li: Buy a New Zealand business outright, or hold at least 25% of its shares
acf.s085_li: Standard route: NZ$1 million; after 3 years running the business, you apply for a Resident Visa
acf.s086_li: Fast route: NZ$2 million; after 12 months running the business, you apply for a Resident Visa
acf.s089_li: Create at least 1 new job for a New Zealand citizen or permanent resident

acf.s092_p: Free public healthcare and free public schooling for your children through the end of secondary school
acf.s093_p: Permanent residence after 12 months on the fast route, or 3 years on the standard route
acf.s094_p: After 5 years of residence, you can apply for New Zealand citizenship
acf.s095_p: The New Zealand passport — visa-free or eVisa access to 180+ countries
acf.s097_p: The fast route reaches permanent residence in just 12 months
acf.s098_p: A reasonable entry level, from NZ$1 million — far below Active Investor Plus
acf.s099_p: Full control over running the business and the investment; it suits people who want to operate a real business
